text:
maria: Quick design flag  I updated the Console view toggle label to 'Tiles' and bumped inter-item gap to token space-6 in the Figma file. Previewed at 1280px  looks cleaner. Thoughts?

lee: Nice. at 1280 it's crisper. i'll run tests at 1024/768 to confirm no table truncation.

anya: Copy nit: 'Tiles' is consistent with other screens. please update the tooltip to 'Toggle to tiles view'.

devon: Accessibility: preserve DOM order so keyboard focus doesn't jump when toggling. and confirm focus ring contrast post-gap change (need >= 3:1).

maria: plan: keep DOM order, toggle layout class only. i'll update aria-labels to 'Switch to tiles view' and 'Tiles view, active'.

lee: I'll add a11y snapshot tests and a visual regression for breakpoints. also adding a CSS var --rdw-gap-tiles mapped to spacing.space-6 for theming.

sam: after merge i'll run a quick smoke on staging (focus flows + keyboard).

design-bot: Figma updated  https://figma.com/file/tiles-update  PR created: #1284 (token alias, aria changes, snapshots).

maria: thanks folks. merging after reviews. small follow-ups: update docs and changelog to mention the token alias and tooltip copy.
